registration.scope: Same AWS A100 6 and 7, phase-04 round-robin pinned model and launch arguments. Benchmark-only instrumented rebuild from the previous release source. Synthetic readiness and soak only.
registration.matching: Complete 180-second cycles. For late indices 840..1199 replay the early job template and fixture seed (index-840). Jobs retain unique workflow IDs and fresh HTTP streams. The middle keeps original seeds and arrival times. Capture existing GPU cache-hit lengths to expose any repeat warming.
registration.ratio_application: Apply the existing +20% threshold to early and late matched windows for each tenant. Preserve the unaltered historical 10-minute summary and threshold result separately. The two windows use the same slow-reader and burst mix.
registration.engine_stage: First/last nonempty text event at the engine publication boundary and terminal in Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC; no token or request bodies in timing logs.
registration.http_stage: First/last nonempty corresponding backend text frame immediately before socket write, and terminal tracker clock. Client records first and last observed SSE content on CLOCK_MONOTONIC.
registration.trace_acceptance: Join completed final requests on replica generation and response ID. Compare count equality and monotonic first/last order across engine, HTTP service and client. Analyze normal and slow clients and paired GPU cache and prompt lengths.
registration.criteria: All noncancelled jobs meet the original correctness/SLO; planned cancellations and counters match; stable resource gauges and cleanup; no overload or sampled foreign GPU apps; 20% limit on matched early/late completion p95 for each tenant. Historical unbalanced 10-minute gate remains reported.
